description: Closes a gap once you've learned the answer (ANSWERED, with the resolution) or decided it doesn't matter (DISMISSED). Keep the registry honest — resolve gaps as their answers land (from an interview, a doc, or the user) so it always reflects what's still unknown. The resolution alone isn't the map: when the answer says something about a page (who does a step, a tool they use, how a decision gets made), write it there too in the same turn, on the page it's about or as the step, person or system it names. Gaps you raised close without a card; a question a person wrote needs their approval.

approvalId.description: Re-call with the approvalId from a needs_confirmation response after the user approves.

resolution.description: The answer / note, when marking ANSWERED.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: compass_gaps_resolve
title: Resolve a Compass open question (gap)
